prompt:
Create one clean 4K landscape architectural cutaway illustration of a modest ancient Chinese county hearing room, for a 2D animated story. This is a single empty room with a short corridor outside its west doorway. No people, no objects on the tables, no labels or diagrams within diagrams.
View: a very high, almost overhead view from the south, looking north. North is the upper edge of the picture, west is left, east is right. Remove the roof and lower only the near south wall. Keep all doorways, every table top, every chair and the continuous floor visible.
There are exactly THREE tables, whose orientations are essential:
1. A magistrate desk centered near the NORTH wall. Its long edge runs LEFT TO RIGHT, parallel to that wall. An empty chair behind it faces south.
2. A long NARROW evidence table is BELOW and to the RIGHT of the magistrate desk. It also runs LEFT TO RIGHT, parallel to the magistrate desk and the north wall. Its rectangular tabletop is four times as long horizontally as it is deep. It must NOT point towards the bottom of the image. Its left end stops at the room's centerline, leaving the west half clear. Leave a walking gap between the magistrate desk and this evidence table. Leave a standing gap south of the table. Its completely bare top can hold five document groups side by side, west to east.
3. A separate SMALL clerk desk sits against the EAST side of the room, farther south than the evidence table. Its long edge runs NORTH TO SOUTH, perpendicular to the evidence table. Its chair is on its east side, facing west. Keep space to sit and move around this small desk.
In the middle of the WEST wall, one open wooden door leads into the short registration corridor. A clear, continuous walking route leads from that door into the empty center and south-center where speakers stand facing north. Tables and chairs never block this route. The entire interior floor is level, with no dais or steps. The north wall behind the magistrate is plain gray plaster with modest timber framing.
Style and light: clean hand-drawn 2D animation background, fine uniform outlines, broad flat muted warm-gray and blue-gray shapes, brown wood, only two values of shading. Soft diffuse daylight, low texture density, no grain, paper texture, photorealistic wood grain or shiny plastic. No signs, legal emblems, text, numbers, arrows, dimensions, extra furniture, props, damage, people or animals. Keep the whole useful layout inside the frame.
